*** tests/unit/acl.tcl.orig
--- tests/unit/acl.tcl
***************
*** 1118,1123 ****
--- 1118,1166 ----
      } {*NOPERM*channel*}
  }
  
+ set server_path [tmpdir "replica.acl"]
+ exec cp -f tests/assets/user.acl $server_path
+ start_server {tags {"acl repl external:skip"}} {
+     set primary [srv 0 client]
+     $primary CONFIG SET repl-diskless-sync-delay 0
+     start_server [list overrides [list "dir" $server_path "aclfile" "user.acl"]] {
+         test {ACL LOAD on a replica preserves the primary connection} {
+             set replica [srv 0 client]
+             $replica REPLICAOF [srv -1 host] [srv -1 port]
+             wait_for_sync $replica
+             set primary_id [lindex [$replica CLIENT LIST TYPE primary] 0]
+             assert_match {id=*} $primary_id
+ 
+             $replica ACL SETUSER default -set
+             $replica ACL SAVE
+             $replica ACL SETUSER default +set
+ 
+             foreach subscribers {0 1} {
+                 if {$subscribers} {
+                     set rd [valkey_deferring_client]
+                     $rd SUBSCRIBE test
+                     assert_equal {subscribe test 1} [$rd read]
+                 }
+ 
+                 assert_equal OK [$replica ACL LOAD]
+                 assert_equal {+@all -set} [dict get [$replica ACL GETUSER default] commands]
+                 assert_equal $primary_id [lindex [$replica CLIENT LIST TYPE primary] 0]
+                 assert_equal up [status $replica master_link_status]
+ 
+                 $primary SET acl-load-key $subscribers
+                 wait_for_ofs_sync $primary $replica
+                 assert_equal $subscribers [$replica GET acl-load-key]
+ 
+                 if {$subscribers} {
+                     assert_equal 1 [$replica PUBLISH test test-message]
+                     assert_equal {message test test-message} [$rd read]
+                     $rd close
+                 }
+             }
+         }
+     }
+ }
+ 
  set server_path [tmpdir "resetchannels.acl"]
  exec cp -f tests/assets/nodefaultuser.acl $server_path
  exec cp -f tests/assets/default.conf $server_path
PATCH
./runtest --single unit/acl --only 'ACL LOAD on a replica preserves the primary connection' > /testbed/tests/tmp/acl-load-baseline.log 2>&1; result=$?; tail -65 /testbed/tests/tmp/acl-load-baseline.log; exit "$result"
